Step 4. A value crosses into the runtime as a word and a kind.
- The two-word lane is modelled on the BinaryCursor lane. The interpreter's extern width limit rises from 4 to 6 words.
- One put, one get (a miss returns the null kind) and one destination put remain.
- Before building, a probe checks a two-register return in both backends.
- Removed: five typed puts, five typed gets, fz_map_dest_put_ref and the four-clause Map.put in lib/map.fz.
- Owner is open: it touches extern lowering and the interpreter, so message those owners before starting.
